source_path.fact: The multimodal wrapper delegates production text execution to general_mm_embed_routine(language_model=self.language_model).
Gemma4TextModel.forward creates auxiliary states solely from its own layers_to_capture list and returns them with hidden states.
The wrapper unpacks the text-model tuple only while its capture flag is true, which repair-9 already sets at wrapper entry.

localized_defect: Repair-9 bound the wrapper state but not the exact delegated Gemma4TextModel forward. A runtime path can reset or replace the text model's layers_to_capture after wrapper entry, leaving no auxiliary states at the logits boundary.
repair: Set the identical physical layer list immediately before Gemma4TextModel.forward, alongside the existing wrapper flag. The recapture remains the same capture-only operation with unchanged workload, split, checkpoint, training, holdout, and endpoint closure.
